checked: unique identifiers and typed edge endpoints
project-relative artifact existence and SHA-256 hashes
deterministic rule replay and generated-file consistency
not_checked: truth or adequacy of the underlying evidence
substantive correctness of node statuses or rationales
construct validity, causal validity, or consequential validity
human analyst agreement or protocol usability
fairness, user benefit, or transfer beyond the replayed cases

edge_semantics.requires: The target analysis is not interpretable unless the source requirement is explicitly satisfied.
edge_semantics.supports: The source provides relevant evidence for the target but does not determine its status.
edge_semantics.does_not_license: Positive evidence at the source must not be converted into the target claim.
edge_semantics.blocks_deployment: Unless the source has affirmative evidence, consequential use at the target remains not justified.

status_propagation_rules.no_automatic_status_propagation: Node states never propagate automatically across an edge.
status_propagation_rules.partial_does_not_license_retention_or_ut: A PARTIAL measurement or empirical-library stability node cannot license retention, transfer, or user-benefit claims.
status_propagation_rules.route_failure_is_local: Failure to demonstrate increment for one acquisition route does not invalidate another route.
status_propagation_rules.untested_utility_blocks_consequential_de: NOT_TESTED downstream utility blocks consequential personalization and durable retention.
status_propagation_rules.unassessed_reference_equity_blocks_reten: When reference-group coverage, subgroup error, and transportability are not assessable, durable retention and transfer remain blocked.

nodes.status_rationale: Same-trial coupling is supported, but magnitude perturbations, interface coupling, and only small matched-set cross-video residual transfer prevent a stable person-warp interpretation.
nodes.review_trigger: Re-review before any durable-profile claim or after a new session, interface, estimator, or cross-video transfer study.

table_en.evidence: Same-trial cross-axis and donor controls; cross-video signed-residual transfer
table_en.boundary: Shared joystick/trial coupling, magnitude perturbations, and geometry remain plausible
table_en.permitted_claim: Interface-contingent temporal structure; limited cross-video constant-residual evidence
table_en.decision: Preserve raw traces and alternative explanations

table_zh.evidence: 同试次跨轴与 donor 对照；跨视频有符号残差迁移
table_zh.boundary: 共享 joystick/试次耦合、幅值扰动与几何解释仍然存在
table_zh.permitted_claim: 受界面约束的时间结构；有限的跨视频常量残差证据
table_zh.decision: 保留原始轨迹与替代解释

nodes.status_rationale: Admissible estimands and DTW objectives materially change ranks, coefficients, calibration gains, and path geometry.
nodes.review_trigger: Re-review whenever the estimand, alignment objective, smoothing, band, or reference estimator changes.
nodes.estimand: five q definitions and four DTW objectives

table_en.evidence: Five estimands; four objectives; nine one-factor parameter settings
table_en.boundary: Ranks, empirical-library stability, calibration, and path geometry change
table_en.decision: Report definition and objective; do not universalize

table_zh.evidence: 五种估计目标；四种目标函数；九个单因素参数设置
table_zh.boundary: 排序、经验视频库稳定性、校准和路径几何发生变化
table_zh.permitted_claim: 依赖估计器的时间偏差画像
table_zh.decision: 报告定义与目标函数；不得普遍化

nodes.status_rationale: The ANOVA ratios are descriptive shared-reference sensitivities: participant scores reuse overlapping leave-one-out references, the induced cross-participant dependence is not modeled, and no unseen-video universe or external reference cohort is observed.
nodes.review_trigger: Re-review after adding videos, changing category support, changing the reference cohort, or obtaining an external item sample.
nodes.estimand: relative and absolute shared-reference variance fractions under empirical-library resampling

table_en.evidence: Descriptive variance ratios; category, reference-size, and 1,000-draw original-identity-exclusion analyses
table_en.boundary: Overlapping references induce unmodeled dependence; no calibrated reliability interpretation or external cohort
table_en.permitted_claim: Reference-aware empirical-library sensitivity for the released support
table_en.decision: Do not apply a reliability cutoff or infer exact-replay, future-video, or trait stability

table_zh.evidence: 描述性方差比、类别、参考人数与 1,000 次原始身份排除分析
table_zh.boundary: 重叠参考诱发的依赖未建模；没有校准过的可靠性解释或外部参考队列
table_zh.permitted_claim: 发布 support 上参考感知的经验视频库敏感性
table_zh.decision: 不使用可靠性阈值，也不推断完全重放、未来视频或 trait 稳定性
